title: Orcas Launch Themselves Onto Beaches to Snatch Sea Lion Pups

scenes.text: Orcas throw themselves onto a beach to catch their dinner.
At Punta Norte in Argentina, they torpedo toward the shore and grab sea lion pups right off the sand.
Then they have to wriggle back, and ride the next wave out to sea.
If they time it wrong, they can get stranded. Fewer than twenty orcas in the world do this.
Young orcas learn it by watching adults. It's a skill passed down through the pod.
A whale on a beach, on purpose.

description:
Orcas in Patagonia deliberately launch themselves onto beaches to catch sea lion pups.
Fewer than 20 orcas worldwide use the technique, and young orcas learn it by watching adults.
Would you have believed it without the video?
first_comment: Smartest hunter in the ocean: orca or octopus?
